user.title: Guestbook
user.description: Select the entities Guestbook should watch. Every field is optional. You can change the selection later.

data_description.doorbells: Doorbell event entities or binary sensors. A ring starts the ring window.
data_description.doors: Door contacts. An opening after a ring turns it into a visit.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion sensors inside the home. Presence after a ring also turns it into a visit.
data_description.locks: Locks whose state changes appear in the visit log.
data_description.residents: Person entities of the people who live here. Residents never become visits.
data_description.resident_signals: Entities that prove a resident is arriving, for example a fingerprint reader or a resident phone.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Guestbook is already set up. Only one instance is allowed.

init.title: Guestbook settings
init.description: Choose what to change. Every part saves on its own and applies at once. Stored entries and open visits are kept.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Entities Guestbook watches. An entity that does not exist raises a repair issue.

data_description.doorbells: Doorbell event entities or binary sensors. A ring starts the ring window.
data_description.doors: Door contacts. An opening after a ring turns it into a visit.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion sensors inside the home. Presence after a ring also turns it into a visit.
data_description.locks: Locks whose state changes appear in the visit log.

residents.title: Residents
residents.description: People who live here and the signals that show one of them arriving.

data_description.residents: Person entities of the people who live here. Residents never become visits.
data_description.resident_signals: Entities that prove a resident is arriving, for example a fingerprint reader or a resident phone.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: The numbers behind the decisions. The defaults suit most homes. A change applies to new decisions and to the end of open visits.

data_description.ring_window: Minutes after a ring in which a door opening or presence makes it a visit.
data_description.resident_window: Minutes around a ring in which a resident signal makes it a resident arrival.
data_description.quiet_period: Minutes without a door opening after which an uncertain visit ends.
data_description.entry_grace: Minutes after the guest came in during which door openings do not count as leaving.
data_description.phone_grace: Minutes a guest's phone may be away before the visit ends.
data_description.max_duration: Hours after which an uncertain visit ends if nothing ended it earlier.
data_description.retention: Days. Closed entries older than this are deleted at startup and once a day. Open visits are never deleted.

pushes.title: Pushes
pushes.description: Choose who gets pushes and which pushes are sent. Companion app phones get buttons. Notify entities get plain text with the entry id.

data_description.phones: Phones with the Home Assistant Companion app. Only these get the buttons of the correction question.
data_description.notify_entities: Notify entities, for example a messenger. They get text only.
data_description.push_arrival: Push when a visit starts and none of the residents is home.
data_description.push_end: Push when a visit ends and none of the residents is home.
data_description.push_correction: Ask for every uncertain visit what it was, also when a resident is home.
data_description.push_unanswered_ring: Push when someone rang and nobody opened.

user.title: Add guest
user.description: Add a guest by name and link the phones that identify them. When a linked phone joins your network, Guestbook records a visit.

data_description.name: The name shown in the visit title.
data_description.trackers: Device trackers of the guest's phones, for example from your router.

reconfigure.title: Edit guest
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the linked phones of this guest.

data_description.name: The name shown in the visit title.
data_description.trackers: Device trackers of the guest's phones, for example from your router.

not_loaded.message: Guestbook is not set up or not loaded.

unknown_entry.message: There is no entry with the id {entry_id}. Use the id from the calendar event or from the sensor attributes.

entry_pending.message: The entry {entry_id} is a ring that is still waiting for a door opening or presence. Correct it after the ring window has ended.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

resident_unlock.name: Resident unlock
resident_unlock.description: Reports that a resident is arriving or opening the door, so a ring close to it is not a visit.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional text that says where the signal came from, for example the name of a lock.

correct_entry.name: Correct entry
correct_entry.description: Tells Guestbook what an entry really was. The original decision is kept next to your correction.

entry_id.name: Entry id
entry_id.description: The id of the visit or ring, shown in the sensor attributes and the bus events.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What the entry really was. A resident is shown in no calendar, a delivery in the rings calendar and a visit in the visits calendar. Unknown keeps the entry where the rules put it.

guest_name.name: Guest name
guest_name.description: Name of the guest, for a visit.

start.name: Start
start.description: Replaces the start time shown in the calendar.

end.name: End
end.description: Replaces the end time shown in the calendar.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text that is kept with the correction.

add_visit.name: Add visit
add_visit.description: Logs a visit the sensors missed.

guests.name: Guests
guests.description: Names of the guests. A name that matches a guest profile uses that profile.

note.name: Note
note.description: Free text that is kept with the visit.

add_note.name: Add note
add_note.description: Adds a free-text note to an entry.

entry_id.name: Entry id
entry_id.description: The id of the visit or ring.

export.name: Export entries
export.description: Writes the entries as JSON lines, one entry per line, to the guestbook folder in the configuration directory. Returns the file path and the number of entries.

start.name: Start
start.description: Only entries that start at or after this time. Without it the export begins with the oldest entry.

end.name: End
end.description: Only entries that start before this time. Without it the export runs to the newest entry.

missing_source.title: Guestbook source is missing
missing_source.description: Guestbook is set to watch {entity_id}, but that entity does not exist. Visits cannot use it. Bring the entity back, or remove it from the sources in the Guestbook settings.

guest.title: Add {name} as a guest
guest.description: A correction named {name} as a visitor, but there is no guest with that name. This creates the guest, so the next visit is recognised without a ring. Phones that were home during the visit and belong to no guest are preselected. Remove the ones that are not theirs.

data_description.trackers: Device trackers of the guest's phones. You can leave this empty and add phones later.

abort.not_loaded: Guestbook is not loaded. Try again when it is running.
